pages.en:
C. I. D.
No. 385
Date. 9/6/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
June 9th 1916.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
It is reported that the Koumingtang branch of the Shanghai rebels regard with disfavour the raising of Li Yuen Hung 黎元洪 to Be President, and intend to oppose the new regime by force of arms. However, they are willing to reconsider the matter if General Yang consents to parley with them. They think General Yang and other officials in the vicinity of Shanghai should resign and that the Republicans who have fought hard for the cause should be appointed to fill the vacancies.
It is reported that Chiangchun Feng Kou Chang has instructed General Yang not to inflict the death penalty on any political offenders for the present but detain them till he receives further orders.
It is reported that Deputy Military Governor Lu will resign soon.
The soldiers have not yet been paid.
Premier Tuan Chi Zen has sent a circular to all Military Governors instructing them to avoid trouble with the independent provinces.
Thirty boxes of ammunition were sent to Nanking by the transport "Oo Bang" 湖朋 which left the Arsenal at 4 a.m. 9th instant.
An old man was arrested at the S.N.R, Station at 7.30 p.m. 8th inst. It is said that he is a fugitive from Peking. He is now detained in the Arsenal and no news has been allowed to leak out regarding his identity or the reason for his arrest.

Your Obedient Servant,

McLarnstrom
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Filed on 12th June 9.

刑事侦缉处
第 385 号
日期：1916 年 6 月 9 日
上海工部局。
1916 年 6 月 9 日。

（印章：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

先生：

据报，上海反叛者的国民党分部对推举黎元洪为总统一事持反对态度，并打算以武力对抗新政权。然而，如果杨将军同意与他们谈判，他们愿意重新考虑此事。他们认为杨将军及上海附近的其他官员应当辞职，空缺职位应由那些为革命事业奋力战斗过的共和派人士担任。

据报，蒋尊簋（音译）（Chiangchun Feng Kou Chang）已指示杨将军，目前暂不对任何政治犯执行死刑，而是将其拘留，直至收到进一步命令。

据报，副督军卢永祥即将辞职。

士兵薪饷尚未发放。

国务总理段祺瑞已向各省督军发出通令，指示他们避免与独立省份发生冲突。

三十箱弹药由运输船“湖朋”号运往南京，该船于本月 9 日凌晨 4 时离开兵工厂。

一名老翁于本月 8 日晚 7 时 30 分在沪宁铁路车站被捕。据说他是来自北京的逃犯。他目前被拘留在兵工厂内，关于其身份或逮捕原因的消息均未外泄。

您顺从的仆人，

麦克拉斯特罗姆
首席侦探督察长。

警察总监。

归档于 6 月 12 日 9 时。
